later_events.mechanism: amendment by substitution of words: Bureau of the Budget redesignated Office of Management and Budget in item (5); substance changed; clause continues amended

clauses.reason: EO 11367 adds item (5), Assistant Director for Executive Management, Bureau of the Budget, Executive Office of the President, to level IV of EO 11248. EO 11540, which states “This order shall be effective July 1, 1970”, amended section 1 of EO 11248 by substituting words in item (5): before, “Assistant Director for Executive Management, Bureau of the Budget, Executive Office of the President”; after, Assistant Director, Office of Management and Budget, Executive Office of the President. Under the strike-and-insert ruling this is a later event and the clause continues, amended (substance changed: note for the human reviewer). EO 11708 section 3 provides “Except with respect to the positions enumerated in section 2” and “Executive Order No. 11248 of October 10, 1965, as amended, is hereby revoked”; section 2 of EO 11708 continues only level V positions, so this level IV item was revoked on March 23, 1973 (signing date). First end: express revocation of the parent order as amended. The “Assistant Director, Office of Management and Budget” placed by section 1(9) of EO 11708 is a new placement under that order, not a continuation of this clause.

inventory_overrides.reason: Inventory correction: the packet's machine segmentation did not match the order's operative units; this span is exact text of the held original and covers the lead or introduction together with the placement or permission it makes operative.

research_rationale:
EO 11367 (signed 1967-08-18; 32 FR 12037) was read in full in the held Federal Register text layer. Acting under section 5317 of title 5, U.S. Code, it amends section 1 of Executive Order No. 11248 of October 10, 1965, as amended, by adding item (5), Assistant Director for Executive Management, Bureau of the Budget, Executive Office of the President, to level IV. The packet's machine inventory had one clause covering only the item and its own-text signals came from an unrelated wildlife rule printed on the same pages; I corrected the inventory by override to the lead plus the item. EO 11540 (effective July 1, 1970, by its own text) amended item (5) by substituting for the words “Assistant Director for Executive Management, Bureau of the Budget, Executive Office of the President” the words Assistant Director, Office of Management and Budget, Executive Office of the President. Under the owner's strike-and-insert ruling (2026-10-21) that is an amendment recorded as a later event, the clause continuing, amended, until its parent ends; the redesignation of the Bureau of the Budget as the Office of Management and Budget changed the wording of the placement (note for the human reviewer: the substance of the item changed). EO 11708 (signed 1973-03-23) section 3 revoked EO 11248 as amended except the level V positions enumerated in its section 2, so the level IV item as amended first ended on 1973-03-23, which is also the whole-order end. Section 1(9) of EO 11708 places an “Assistant Director, Office of Management and Budget” in level IV as a new placement under that order's own text. Original not an authenticated transcription: the held text is the OCR text layer of the official Federal Register issue; quotations avoid its recognition errors.
